I can do that — before I remove it I need you to confirm a few details so I cancel the correct event:

1. Which event exactly? (I assume the recurring "Design Critique" at Wednesdays 16:00 on your primary/work calendar — is that right? If there are multiple "Design Critique" events, give the next-occurrence date or event ID.)
2. Scope: cancel a single upcoming occurrence, "this and following" occurrences, or the entire recurring series?
3. Time zone (if not your calendar default)?
4. Notify attendees? If yes, do you want a custom cancellation message (paste it here) or should I send a default: "Design Critique canceled — reviews will be handled asynchronously going forward."?
5. Any attendees who should NOT be notified?

Reply with your choices and I’ll proceed.
